"Urban settlements are generally large, compact, and engaged in non-agricultural secondary, tertiary, and quaternary pursuits. The process of urbanization has accelerated globally, leading to the rapid emergence of metropolitan cities and mega cities. According to the United Nations, a 'mega city' or 'megapolis' is an urban agglomeration with a total population exceeding 10 million inhabitants. The world's first city to attain a population of one million was London around 1800, followed by Paris in 1850 and New York in 1860. In India, Census classifies urban centers into six classes, where Class I cities have populations over 100,000. questionText:
Match List I (Rural Settlement Pattern) with List II (Terrain / Spatial Feature):

List I:
(A) Linear Pattern
(B) Circular Pattern
(C) Star-like Pattern
(D) Rectangular Pattern

List II:
(I) Around a central lake, pond, or village common pasture
(II) Along a road, railway line, river levee, or canal embankment
(III) Flat fertile plains with roads intersecting at right angles
(IV) Convergence of multiple roads with houses radiating outward

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-IV, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-IV, C-III, D-I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Linear pattern develops along roads/rivers (II); Circular pattern develops around lakes/ponds (I); Star-like develops along converging roads (IV); Rectangular develops in flat plains (III).
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.

questionText: What are the major environmental consequences of rapid, unplanned rural-to-urban migration in Indian megacities?

options.text: Overcrowding in cities, proliferation of unhygienic slums, severe strain on civic infrastructure, water depletion, and untreated sewage discharge
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: The complete elimination of municipal solid waste
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Instant conversion of city streets into pristine national parks
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Reduction in urban air pollution to absolute zero
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Unchecked rural-urban migration places acute pressure on urban infrastructure, causing housing deficits, growth of unauthorized slums, water shortages, traffic congestion, and solid waste crises in metropolitan cities.
Hence, Option C is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
